positions.title: DevOps Engineer
description: Moved from intern to full-time by scaling, maintaining and improving the k3s and observability stack, and replicating it across multiple production servers and project environments.
Lead DevOps and infrastructure for high-stakes public sector projects, including critical deployments for the Gujarat Government with strict reliability and performance standards.
Designed and built production-grade CI/CD pipelines that shortened development and testing cycles and sped up deployments.

positions.title: DevOps Intern
description: Established production-grade observability on resource-constrained staging servers by migrating from Apache Webserver & Tomcat to k3s, replacing Prometheus with VictoriaMetrics + Loki.
Cut tooling costs by 67% ($300 to $100/month) by migrating 25 engineers from Jira + Bitbucket to GitHub Teams, replicating full project management workflows via GitHub Actions.
Reduced deployment cycles from bi-weekly releases to 2–3 per day by building CI/CD pipelines for 55+ apps (React, Java, Python), with pipeline runtimes under 2 minutes.
Enforced schema change accountability with a version-controlled DB pipeline, replacing a shared all-access DB user with auditable deployment change logs.
Resolved dev environment inconsistencies by centralizing staging DBs and setting up redundant MySQL and PostgreSQL instances for continuity during an infrastructure transition.
Ran k6 performance tests across application modules to validate scalability and reliability under load.
